info.title: YapSpace API
info.description: Public API for YapSpace, the shared discussion layer for web pages.

get.summary: Liveness: 200 while the process is serving, 503 once shutdown has started.
Readiness: 200 when the database answers within 2 s and the process is not draining, else 503.

200.description: The database answers and the process is not draining

503.description: Not ready: the database is unreachable or shutdown has started

post.summary: Signs in with a username and password.
Revokes the session that made the request.
Resets the password with a recovery code. Every session is revoked, and a new recovery code is issued.
Creates an account and returns a session and the recovery code (shown once).
Creates the discussion for a page, or returns the existing one (200).
Looks up the discussion for a page. This never creates one.

200.description: Identity and the discussion if one exists

get.summary: Reads a discussion. A merged discussion returns its target, and `merged_from` names the id that was asked for.

parameters.name: before_seq
parameters.description: Return messages with a seq below this value (older messages).

parameters.name: after_seq
parameters.description: Return messages with a seq above this value (newer messages).

post.summary: Posts a message. Send the same `client_msg_id` again to retry. A retry returns the stored message with 200.

delete.summary: Deletes the account. Sessions end now, and message bodies are erased within a few minutes by a background job.

get.summary: Lists the users you have blocked.

put.summary: Blocks a user. Repeating the call does nothing.

get.summary: Streams a JSON export of the account: profile, sessions and every message, in batches.

post.summary: Changes the password. Every other session is revoked, and the current one stays signed in.
Replaces the recovery code. The password must be confirmed first.

get.summary: Lists the active sessions, most recently used first.

delete.summary: Revokes one of your own sessions. Someone else's session id returns 404, so ids cannot be probed.
Deletes your own message. The body is erased and the message becomes a tombstone, so replies stay valid.

404.description: No such message, or it is not yours

post.summary: Hides a discussion from everyone except moderators.
Locks a discussion: nobody can post until it is unlocked.
Removes a message from public view. The body is kept for appeals, and a job erases it after 90 days.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

post.summary: Marks a report as actioned or dismissed.
Suspends an account. Moderators cannot suspend other moderators or admins. Suspended accounts can still read.
Reports something. Reporting the same thing again returns the existing report with 200.

get.summary: A public profile: id, username and creation time.

AuthResponse.description: Returned by register, login and recovery. `recovery_code` is shown once, on register and recovery only.

AuthorDto.description: Author of a message. `null` when the author's account has been deleted.

reason.description: One of the reasons in api.md §F.2, for example `spam` or `wrong_discussion`.

password.description: Confirms the deletion. A deleted account cannot be recovered.

DiscussionDto.description: A discussion. `merged_from` is set when the requested id was merged into this discussion.

IdentityDto.description: The identity a page resolved to. This is shown in the panel, so users can check which discussion they are on.

MessageDto.description: A message. `body` is `null` unless the message is visible, so removed and deleted text never leaves the server.

ParentDto.description: The message a reply points to. The excerpt and author are hidden when that message is not visible.

client_msg_id.description: Client-generated id, reused on retries so a message is never stored twice.

parent_id.description: The message this one replies to. It must be visible and in the same discussion.

PublicUserDto.description: A user as other people see them. No role and no status.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

report_id.description: The report this action resolves, if any.

recovery_code.description: The recovery code, in any case, with or without dashes.

client_label.description: Shown in the session list, for example "Chrome extension".

password.description: 10-128 characters. Must not equal the username.

canonical_url.description: The page's `<link rel="canonical">`, if it has one.

url.description: The URL the browser is showing.

oneOf.description: `null` when nobody has started a discussion for this page yet.

current.description: True for the session that made this request.

until.description: When the suspension ends (RFC 3339). Omit for an indefinite suspension.
